LOAN AGREEMENT 
 
 This Loan Agreement (“ Agreement ”) is entered into on this ________________ (“ Effective Date ”): 
 
 BY AND BETWEEN 
 
 DUBIZZLE GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED , a company incorporated under the laws of Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), United Arab Emirates (UAE) , with its registered office at Office no. 26, Level 3, Gate Village Building 10, International Financial Centre (DIFC), UAE acting through its duly authorized representative Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan (hereinafter referred to as “ Lender ” which expression shall mean and include, where the context so requires or admits, its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns.) 
 
 AND 
 
 DUBIZZLE LABS (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan , with its registered office at 8 th Floor, Mega Tower, 63-B, Main Boulevard, Main Gulberg, Lahore acting through its duly authorized representative Mr. Imran Ali Khan (hereinafter referred to as “ Borrower ” which expression shall mean and include, where the context so requires or admits, its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns.) 
 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Lender, namely Dubizzle Group Holdings Limited, is the parent company of the Borrower, namely Dubizzle Labs (SMC-Private) Limited; 
 
 The Lender is willing to advance a revolving line of credit to the Borrower and the Borrower is desirous of obtaining such revolving line of credit from the Lender; and 
 
 The Lender has the will to advance the revolving line of credit to the Borrower and the Borrower has the capacity to repay the same, along with interest, to the Lender, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties hereby agree as follows : 
 
 LOAN 
 
 This Agreement shall be effective from [●] (“ Effective Date ”). 
 
 Subject to the terms of this Agreement, the Lender hereby extends a revolving line of credit (the “ Credit Facility ”) up to a maximum amount of Rs. 3 ,000,000,000 (Rupees Three Billion ) (the " Credit Limit ") to the Borrower. 
 
 The Borrower may utilise the Credit Facility as per its requirements, at the Borrower’s option, through direct or indirect payments, transfer of funds, or direct payments made to or on behalf of the Borrower, from time to time up to a maximum of the Credit Limit. 
 The Parties may convert the utilized amount of the Credit Facility (“ Utilized Amount ”) into share capital of Dubizzle Labs ( SMC- Private) Limited, subject to applicable laws. 
 
 INTEREST 
 
 The Credit Facility shall be advanced as an interest-free loan. 
 
 REPAYMENT 
 
 The Borrower shall repay the Utilized Amount to the Lender or to the Lender’s nominee as specified by the Lender from time to time. The Utilized Amount shall become due and repayable within [●] days of utilization of such amount. 
 
 COSTS 
 
 The Lender and the Borrower shall each pay their own respective costs, taxes and fees in connection with the implementation of the Loan Agreement. 
 
 REPRESENTATIONS &amp; WARRANTIES 
 
 Legal Capacity of Parties: Parties are companies duly incorporated and validly existing under the laws of Pakistan, and declare that they have the right, capacity and full power to enter into and perform this Agreement. 
 
 Enforceability of the Agreement: Parties have taken all actions necessary for execution and performance of this Agreement and completion of the transactions contemplated hereby. 
 
 Books and records: The books and records of the Parties are up to date and in compliance with applicable law(s). 
 
 GENERAL CLAUSES 
 
 Notices 
 : Any notice herein referred to shall be in writing and shall be sufficiently given to or served on the Party to whom it is addressed via registered post or email. Notice shall be deemed to have been delivered, four (4) working days after posting, if sent by registered post; or if sent by email, twenty-four (24) hours after sending the email. 
 
 Entire Agreement: This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the Parties and overrides any and all verbal or written arrangements made by and between the Parties prior to the execution hereof. 
 
 Governing Law: This Agreement will be construed in accordance with and governed by the laws of Islamic Republic of Pakistan. 
 
 Arbitration: A ny dispute under or arising out of this Agreement shall be referred in accordance with the Arbitration Act, 1940 and the decision of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on the Parties. 
 Interpretation: 
 
 Headings are inserted for the convenience of the Parties only and are not to be considered when interpreting this Agreement. 
 
 Words in the singular mean and include the plural and vice versa. 
 
 All capitalized terms are defined in the Agreement. 
 
 Reference to any gender mean and include all genders. 
 
 Force Majeure: If either Party fails to fulfil its obligations hereunder when such failure is due to an act of God, or other circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to fire, flood, civil commotion, protests, riot, war (declared and undeclared), revolution, or embargoes, then said failure shall not be considered a default of obligations hereunder for the duration of such event, and for such time thereafter as is reasonable to enable the affected Party or Parties to resume performance under this Agreement, provided however, that in no event shall such time extend for a period of more than ten business days. 
 
 Amendments: This Agreement may not be amended except by an instrument in writing signed for and on behalf of both Parties. 
 
 Severability: The provisions of this Agreement are severable. 
 
 Counterparts: This Agreement may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument.
